title: Allow agentless orchestration procedures
description:
As a procedure author, I want a workflow that only composes host tools, state, stages, and human review to execute without a fake LLM agent, so that orchestration-only procedures remain honest and minimal.

Feature: Agentless procedure orchestration

Scenario: Run a procedure with no agent declarations
  Given a valid procedure uses only host tools, state, stages, and human interactions
  And it declares no agents
  When Tactus validates and executes the procedure
  Then validation succeeds
  And the procedure advances through its orchestration steps

Scenario: Reject an undeclared agent reference
  Given a procedure declares no agents
  But its code invokes an agent primitive by name
  When Tactus validates the procedure
  Then validation fails with an undeclared-agent error

Out of scope: creating implicit agents or changing model configuration.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Validation update: agentless orchestration behavior passes the full 4,203-test Tactus suite, 449 Behave scenarios, 24 stdlib tests, repository-wide Black/Ruff, and the focused runtime/structured-HITL suite.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Combined release validation confirms agentless orchestration remains green: 4,278 non-integration tests, 456 Behave scenarios, and 487 isolated Python 3.11 Plexus consumer tests passed from a clean wheel.
